output.reasoning: This posting fails on role type and on level, and either one alone would be enough to reject it. Role type: the title is 'Director, Revenue Accounting' in the Finance department. The duties are revenue recognition under ASC 606, accounts receivable accounting, CECL analysis under ASC 326, month-end close, and coordinating external audits. This is not hands-on ML, NLP, or AI engineering and matches none of Ananya's target roles (Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, ML Engineer, Research Engineer). Her MS in Computer Science (AI concentration) and her Machine Learning Engineer co-op building RAG and transformer classifiers are unrelated to this work. Level: this is a Director-level role that explicitly requires 10+ years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years in public accounting, plus experience managing and mentoring accounting staff. That is far beyond a new grad finishing an MS in December 2026. Skills: the required section names only accounting standards (ASC 606, ASC 326) and no specific technologies. Under the rules the skills test is skipped. SQL and ERP systems such as NetSuite ARM appear only as nice-to-haves, so overlap with her SQL skill does not help. Location: San Francisco, CA and Seattle, WA are US-based, which would be acceptable since she is willing to relocate within the US. Sponsorship: the posting says 'We do sponsor visas!', which would be acceptable given that she needs sponsorship. Location and sponsorship pass, but the role-type and level failures are disqualifying.
